     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeRedesignRankOneFibre
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeRedesignChartReadIdeal
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Rank-one fibre reduction for the chart colength
    11	
    12	This is the geometric wrapper around `RankOneFibre`: the genuine chart-reading ideal is mapped
    13	to `B/(read s)`, and that image is definitionally `chartIdealColengthModule`.  Thus a pointwise
    14	span statement for the fibre of the ideal immediately gives the desired vanishing of the
    15	colength fibre.  The span statement is allowed to include the zero-fibre case.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    24	open scoped TensorProduct
    25	
    26	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    27	
    28	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    29	
    30	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    31	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    32	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] {a : ℕ}
    33	
    34	namespace ThetaGeneratorSeed
    35	
    36	/-- **Pointwise chart-colength fibre vanishing from ideal-fibre span.**  Let `B` be the
    37	pinned-chart section ring, `J` the genuine `B`-ideal generated by the readings of `K`, and
    38	`I = (read s)` for `s ∈ K`.  If every vector of
    39	`κ(p) ⊗[B] J` is a scalar multiple of `1 ⊗ read(s)`, then the image of `J` in `B/I` has
    40	zero `κ(p)`-fibre.  This is the exact single-point input consumed by the `κ(z)` RD-N bridge;
    41	it uses no global base-fibre or flatness inference. -/
    42	theorem subsingleton_chartIdealColengthModule_tensor_residueField_of_ideal_span
    43	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
    44	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) (hsK : s ∈ K)
    45	    (p : PrimeSpectrum Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b))
    46	    (hspan : ∀ v : p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[
    47	        Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)]
    48	        (chartReadIdeal K b), ∃ c : p.asIdeal.ResidueField,
    49	          c • ((1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[
    50	            Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)]
    51	            (⟨relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s,
    52	              by
    53	                exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨s, hsK⟩, rfl⟩⟩ :
    54	              chartReadIdeal K b)) = v) :
    55	    Subsingleton ((chartIdealColengthModule K b s) ⊗[
    56	      Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
    57	  let B : Type u := Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)
    58	  let I : Ideal B := Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s}
    59	  let P : Submodule B B := chartReadIdeal K b
    60	  let f : B →ₗ[B] (B ⧸ I) := (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ B I).toLinearMap
    61	  have hsP : relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s ∈ P := by
    62	    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨s, hsK⟩, rfl⟩
    63	  have hfs : f (relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s) = 0 := by
    64	    change Ideal.Quotient.mk I (relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s) = 0
    65	    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
    66	  have hzero := RankOneFibre.subsingleton_map_tensor_of_span_singleton
    67	    P f (relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s) hsP (by
    68	      · intro v
    69	        exact hspan v) (by
    70	      · exact hfs)
    71	  change Subsingleton ((P.map f) ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) at hzero
    72	  exact hzero
    73	
    74	end ThetaGeneratorSeed
    75	
    76	end AlgebraicGeometry

319 AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0RankOneLocalDivisor.lean
     1	/-
     2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
     3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOnePresentation
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSurjectiveEffectivity
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyMonoH1
     9	import Mathlib.RingTheory.TensorProduct.Finite
    10	
    11	/-!
    12	# The consumed local divisor package for the rank-one route
    13	
    14	This module is the first divisor consumer of PicRankOneLocalPresentation.  The projective
    15	rank-one H0 module supplies a basic open and a section which is nonzero on every residue fibre
    16	there.  The datum-side section construction then gives regular local equations, and the widened
    17	effectivity engine packages those equations as a DivFamZarAff of degree genus C.
    18	
    19	The package is deliberately local and presentation-tied.  It does not define the canonical
    20	family-level divisorOfRankOne, identify the equations with the native zero locus, or assert
    21	that the rank-one locus is represented by an open subscheme.  Those remain the next contracts.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	
    26	universe u
    27	
    28	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    29	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    30	open scoped TensorProduct
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    35	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    36	
    37	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    38	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    39	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    40	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    41	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    42	variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    43	
    44	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    45	
    46	/- The degree theorem needs the base-change geometric package under the local relCurve instance,
    47	   which has lower priority in the general curve API. -/
    48	noncomputable local instance (priority := 20000) rankOneLocalDivisorOver
    49	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    50	    (relCurve C L).Over (Spec (.of L)) :=
    51	  instOverBaseChange C L
    52	
    53	noncomputable local instance rankOneLocalDivisorSmooth
    54	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    55	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
    56	  instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
    57	
    58	noncomputable local instance rankOneLocalDivisorIntegral
    59	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    60	    IsIntegral (relCurve C L) :=
    61	  instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
    62	
    63	noncomputable local instance rankOneLocalDivisorQuasiCompact
    64	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    65	    QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
    66	  instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
    67	
    68	noncomputable local instance rankOneLocalDivisorFiniteH0
    69	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    70	    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
    71	  instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L
    72	
    73	noncomputable local instance rankOneLocalDivisorFiniteH1
    74	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    75	    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
    76	  instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L
    77	
    78	/-! ## Regularity and degree of the local equations -/
    79	
    80	/-- The local equations cut from the tied datum section remain regular after every field-valued
    81	coefficient extension.  This is the regularity input consumed by the widened effectivity
    82	engine, derived from the same fibrewise nonvanishing hypothesis used in the construction. -/
    83	theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_fibrewiseRegular
    84	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    85	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    86	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    87	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    88	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
    89	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    90	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    91	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    92	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    93	    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) L]
    94	    [IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away f) L]
    95	    (z : relCurve C L) :
    96	    ((relCurve C L).presheaf.germ
    97	      (((P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).cover.pullback
    98	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)).opens z) z
    99	      (((P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).cover.pullback
   100	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)).mem_opens z)).hom
   101	      (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn
   102	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)
   103	        (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy) z) ∈
   104	      nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C L).presheaf.stalk z) := by
   105	  let B := Localization.Away f
   106	  let D := P.datum.baseChange B
   107	  let s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) :=
   108	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y
   109	  have hsec : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
   110	      D.sectionsMapTop q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   111	        (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y) ≠ 0 :=
   112	    fun q => P.sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero f y hy q
   113	  have hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (q : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
   114	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   115	    fun j q => D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero
   116	      s q (hsec q) j
   117	  unfold baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
   118	  exact D.germ_self_pullbackEqn_sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular
   119	    s hfib L z
   120	
   121	/-- The local equations have the genus class degree after every field-valued extension.  The
   122	calculation uses the datum class law and datum_classDeg_baseChange, so the degree is tied to
   123	the presentation rather than supplied as an unrelated witness. -/
   124	theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_classDeg
   125	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   126	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   127	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   128	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   129	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   130	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   131	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   132	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   133	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   134	    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) L]
   135	    [IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away f) L] :
   136	    classDeg L
   137	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)
   138	        (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).picClass) = genus C := by
   139	  letI : Algebra P.cover.Carrier L :=
   140	    ((algebraMap (Localization.Away f) L).comp
   141	      (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f))).toAlgebra
   142	  haveI : IsScalarTower P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f) L :=
   143	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
   144	  haveI : IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L :=
   145	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
   146	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, RingHom.comp_assoc,
   147	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f),
   148	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k (Localization.Away f) L])
   149	  rw [P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_picClass f y hy,
   150	    P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange (Localization.Away f),
   151	    ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
   152	    relCurveMap_comp]
   153	  exact P.datum_classDeg_baseChange L
   154	
   155	/-! ## The local widened divisor and its immediate consumer -/
   156	
   157	/- The next canonicality edge is expressed first in the localized H⁰ module.  The datum
   158	   section/native comparison needed to transport this unit to local equations is deliberately
   159	   a separate contract. -/
   160	theorem existsUnique_unit_tensorAway_rankOne_generators
   161	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   162	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   163	    (y y' : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   164	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   165	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   166	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   167	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   168	    (hy' : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   169	      (y' ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   170	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   171	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   172	    ∃! v : (Localization.Away f)ˣ,
   173	      ((1 : Localization.Away f) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y') =
   174	        (v : Localization.Away f) •
   175	          ((1 : Localization.Away f) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y) := by
   176	  let B := Localization.Away f
   177	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0
   178	  letI : Module.Finite P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_finite
   179	  letI : Module.Projective P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_projective
   180	  have hrankB : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
   181	      Module.rankAtStalk (B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) q = 1 := by
   182	    intro q
   183	    rw [Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange]
   184	    exact P.h0_rank_one (PrimeSpectrum.comap
   185	      (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B) q)
   186	  exact Module.existsUnique_unit_smul_of_forall_tmul_ne_zero
   187	    hrankB ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y) ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y')
   188	    (AlgebraicGeometry.PicRankOneLocalPresentation.tensorAwayGenerator_fibre_ne_zero
   189	      f y hy)
   190	    (AlgebraicGeometry.PicRankOneLocalPresentation.tensorAwayGenerator_fibre_ne_zero
   191	      f y' hy')
   192	
   193	/-- The widened divisor cut by a tied rank-one section on its basic open. -/
   194	noncomputable def baseOpenRankOneDivisor
   195	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   196	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   197	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   198	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   199	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   200	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   201	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   202	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   203	    DivFamZarAff C (Localization.Away f) (genus C) :=
   204	  divFamZarAffOfFibrewiseRegularLocalEquations C (genus C)
   205	    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy) pi
   206	    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_fibrewiseRegular f y hy)
   207	    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_classDeg f y hy)
   208	
   209	@[simp]
   210	theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass
   211	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   212	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   213	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   214	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   215	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   216	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   217	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   218	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   219	    (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy).picClass =
   220	      (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away f)).cechPicClass := by
   221	  unfold baseOpenRankOneDivisor
   222	  rw [picClass_divFamZarAffOfFibrewiseRegularLocalEquations]
   223	  exact P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_picClass f y hy
   224	
   225	/-- The Abel value of the local divisor is the restriction of the input Picard datum.  This is
   226	the immediate consumer which keeps the widened divisor tied to the chosen presentation. -/
   227	theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_abelAff
   228	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   229	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   230	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   231	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   232	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   233	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   234	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   235	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   236	    abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away f) (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy) =
   237	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)).restrictScalars k)
   238	        (PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   239	          (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
   240	  let B := Localization.Away f
   241	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
   242	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
   243	  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] B :=
   244	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier B).restrictScalars k
   245	  let F := P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy
   246	  have hFclass : F.picClass = (P.datum.baseChange B).cechPicClass :=
   247	    P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass f y hy
   248	  have hrel : (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)) F.picClass =
   249	      relPicAlgMap C psi (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   250	    rw [hFclass, P.datum_class, relPicAlgMap_mk]
   251	    have hcurve : Over.Hom.left (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi) =
   252	        relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B := by
   253	      refine congrArg (fun f : overSpec k B ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
   254	      exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
   255	    rw [P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange B, hcurve]
   256	    rfl
   257	  calc
   258	    abelDivAffPlus C B F = PicEtAff.unit C B ((relPicMk C (overSpec k B)) F.picClass) := rfl
   259	    _ = PicEtAff.unit C B (relPicAlgMap C psi
   260	      (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by rw [hrel]

425 AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/DivRankOneOpen.lean
     1	/-
     2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
     3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocus
     7	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Restrict
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# The universal divisor rank-one open contract
    11	
    12	The genus divisor representer is unconditional, while the rank-one restriction still needs a
    13	family-level open-locus producer.  This file separates those two facts.  The predicate below is
    14	the inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` along the represented universal Abel map.  A
    15	`DivRankOneOpenData` witness identifies that predicate with the range of one actual open of the
    16	representer; only after that witness is supplied do we define the open subscheme.
    17	
    18	This shape prevents a logical `Subfunctor` from being silently reinterpreted as a scheme.  It also
    19	gives the canonical inverse lane a stable contract: it consumes the witness equality and can use
    20	the resulting open inclusion and all of its pullbacks without choosing a generator.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    25	
    26	universe u
    27	
    28	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    29	
    30	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    31	
    32	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    33	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    34	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    35	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    36	
    37	noncomputable section
    38	
    39	/-- The universal genus-divisor predicate whose Abel class lies in `PicRankOneOpen`. -/
    40	def divRankOneUniversalPredicate :
    41	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
    42	  divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi
    43	
    44	/-- Evaluation of the represented genus Abel map on a slice point, with the base morphism
    45	transported from the point in the divisor representer to its source. -/
    46	theorem abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne
    47	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    48	    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
    49	    (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.left) q.left =
    50	      (⟨T.hom,
    51	        (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    52	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩ :
    53	        (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    54	          (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) := by
    55	  change (⟨q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom, _⟩ :
    56	      (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    57	        (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) =
    58	    ⟨T.hom,
    59	      (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    60	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩
    61	  refine Over.sigmaExtension_ext
    62	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) q.w ?_
    63	  let e : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶ T :=
    64	    Over.mkCongr q.w
    65	  let q' : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶
    66	      divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
    67	    Over.homMk q.left rfl
    68	  have hq : e ≫ q = q' := by
    69	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    70	    exact Category.id_comp _

    94	/-- A represented genus divisor lies in the universal predicate exactly when its Abel image

   103	          (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left := by
   104	  simp only [divRankOneUniversalPredicate,
   105	    divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter,
   106	    Subfunctor.preimage_obj, Set.mem_preimage]
   107	  let p := (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app T
   108	    ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv x)
   109	  change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔ _
   110	  have hleft :
   111	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left =
   112	        (⟨T.unop.hom, p⟩ :
   113	          (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   114	            (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj

   120	    rw [hleft]
   121	    rfl

   123	    rw [hleft] at hv

   134	            ((PicRankOneOpen pi).ι.app

   195	  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
   196	    have hxy : x.left = y.left ≫ U.ι := by
   197	      have hleft := congrArg Over.Hom.left hy

   199	    have hrange : Set.range x.left.base ⊆ Set.range snd.base := by

   211	    have hcomm := congrArg
   212	      (fun f => (ConcreteCategory.hom f) u) hpbT.1

   214	        (fst.app (op T.unop.left) u) =
   215	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) (u ≫ snd) at hcomm
   216	    simpa only [hu] using hcomm
   217	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   218	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := hpbT.2.2 v x.left hv
   219	    change u ≫ snd = x.left at hu₂
   220	    have hrange : Set.range x.left.base ⊆ Set.range U.ι.base := by
   221	      rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
   222	      change Set.range x.left.base ⊆ snd.opensRange
   223	      rw [Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange]
   224	      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
   225	      refine ⟨u.base t, ?_⟩
   226	      have happ := congrArg (fun f => f.base t) hu₂
   227	      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using happ
   228	    let V : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   229	      Over.mk (U.ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)
   230	    let j : V ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
   231	      Over.homMk (U := V) U.ι

   234	      IsOpenImmersion.lift U.ι x.left hrange

   237	      subst e
   238	      rfl
   239	    have hl : l' ≫ j.left = x.left := by
   240	      dsimp only [l']

   242	      dsimp only [l]

   245	      rw [← j.w, ← Category.assoc, hl]

   248	    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
   249	    change y ≫ j = x
   250	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext

    16	/-!
    17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
    18	
    19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
    20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
    21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
    22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
    23	
    24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
    25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
    26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
    27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
    28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
    29

    31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
    32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
    33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
    34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that

     6	import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Basic
     7	import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.RightExactness
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Rank-one fibre quotients
    11	
    12	If a vector `1 ⊗ s` is nonzero in a one-dimensional fibre `K ⊗[B] M`, then it spans that
    13	fibre.  Consequently, every surjective image of `M` that kills `s` has zero `K`-fibre.
    14	
    15	The mapped-submodule form is tailored to an ideal `J ≤ B`: if the fibre of `J` has rank one,
    16	`s ∈ J` survives in that fibre, and a quotient map kills `s`, then the image of `J` in the
    17	quotient has zero residue-field fibre.  This is purely right exactness of tensor product;
    18	neither flatness nor finite generation over `B` is needed at this step.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open scoped TensorProduct
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28	
    29	namespace RankOneFibre
    30	
    31	/-- A surjective image has zero field fibre when every source-fibre vector is a scalar multiple
    32	of `1 ⊗ s`, and the image kills `s`.  The spanning hypothesis also covers the zero-fibre case;
    33	no dimension or nonzero-vector assumption is required. -/
    34	theorem subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_span_singleton
    35	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
    36	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    37	    (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (s : M)
    38	    (hspan : ∀ v : K ⊗[B] M, ∃ c : K, c • ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] s) = v)
    39	    (hfs : f s = 0) :
    40	    Subsingleton (N ⊗[B] K) := by
    41	  have hft : Function.Surjective (f.lTensor K) :=
    42	    LinearMap.lTensor_surjective K hf
    43	  have hzero : ∀ v : K ⊗[B] M, (f.lTensor K) v = 0 := by
    44	    intro v
    45	    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hspan v
    46	    rw [← hc, ← TensorProduct.tmul_eq_smul_one_tmul c s,
    47	      LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, hfs]
    48	    simp
    49	  have hsub : Subsingleton (K ⊗[B] N) := by
    50	    refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩
    51	    obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hft x
    52	    obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := hft y
    53	    rw [hzero x', hzero y']
    54	  exact (TensorProduct.comm B N K).toEquiv.subsingleton
    55	
    56	/-- A surjective image of a module has zero field fibre if it kills a nonzero vector spanning
    57	the one-dimensional source fibre. -/
    58	theorem subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_finrank_eq_one
    59	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
    60	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    61	    (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (s : M)
    62	    (hfin : Module.finrank K (K ⊗[B] M) = 1)
    63	    (hs : (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] s ≠ 0) (hfs : f s = 0) :
    64	    Subsingleton (N ⊗[B] K) := by
    65	  apply subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_span_singleton f hf s
    66	  · intro v
    67	    exact exists_smul_eq_of_finrank_eq_one hfin hs v
    68	  · exact hfs
    69	
    70	/-- If a linear map kills a generator of a one-dimensional source fibre, the fibre of its
    71	range is zero. -/
    72	theorem subsingleton_range_tensor_of_finrank_eq_one
    73	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
    74	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    75	    (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (s : M)
    76	    (hfin : Module.finrank K (K ⊗[B] M) = 1)
    77	    (hs : (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] s ≠ 0) (hfs : f s = 0) :
    78	    Subsingleton ((LinearMap.range f) ⊗[B] K) := by
    79	  apply subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_finrank_eq_one f.rangeRestrict
    80	    (LinearMap.surjective_rangeRestrict f) s hfin hs
    81	  apply Subtype.ext
    82	  exact hfs
    83	
    84	/-- Range specialization of `subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_span_singleton`. -/
    85	theorem subsingleton_range_tensor_of_span_singleton
    86	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
    87	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    88	    (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (s : M)
    89	    (hspan : ∀ v : K ⊗[B] M, ∃ c : K, c • ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] s) = v)
    90	    (hfs : f s = 0) :
    91	    Subsingleton ((LinearMap.range f) ⊗[B] K) := by
    92	  apply subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_span_singleton f.rangeRestrict
    93	    (LinearMap.surjective_rangeRestrict f) s hspan
    94	  apply Subtype.ext
    95	  exact hfs
    96	
    97	/-- Let `P` be a submodule whose field fibre is one-dimensional.  If `s ∈ P` survives in
    98	that fibre and `f s = 0`, then the fibre of the image `f(P)` is zero.
    99	
   100	For a chart ideal `J` and the quotient map `B → B/(s)`, the conclusion is precisely the
   101	vanishing of the fibre of the image of `J` in `B/(s)`. -/
   102	theorem subsingleton_map_tensor_of_finrank_eq_one
   103	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
   104	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
   105	    (P : Submodule B M) (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (s : M) (hsP : s ∈ P)
   106	    (hfin : Module.finrank K (K ⊗[B] P) = 1)
   107	    (hs : (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] (⟨s, hsP⟩ : P) ≠ 0) (hfs : f s = 0) :
   108	    Subsingleton ((P.map f) ⊗[B] K) := by
   109	  rw [← LinearMap.range_domRestrict P f]
   110	  apply subsingleton_range_tensor_of_finrank_eq_one
   111	    (f.domRestrict P) (⟨s, hsP⟩ : P) hfin hs
   112	  simpa using hfs
   113	
   114	/-- Mapped-submodule specialization of `subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_span_singleton`.
   115	This is useful when the source ideal fibre may itself be zero. -/
   116	theorem subsingleton_map_tensor_of_span_singleton
   117	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
   118	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
   119	    (P : Submodule B M) (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (s : M) (hsP : s ∈ P)
   120	    (hspan : ∀ v : K ⊗[B] P, ∃ c : K,
   121	      c • ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] (⟨s, hsP⟩ : P)) = v) (hfs : f s = 0) :
   122	    Subsingleton ((P.map f) ⊗[B] K) := by
   123	  rw [← LinearMap.range_domRestrict P f]
   124	  apply subsingleton_range_tensor_of_span_singleton
   125	    (f.domRestrict P) (⟨s, hsP⟩ : P) hspan
   126	  simpa using hfs
   127	
   128	/-- Quotienting by a vector that survives and spans a one-dimensional field fibre produces
   129	a quotient with zero field fibre. -/
   130	theorem subsingleton_quotient_span_tensor_of_finrank_eq_one
   131	    {B K M : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
   132	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M]
   133	    (s : M) (hfin : Module.finrank K (K ⊗[B] M) = 1)
   134	    (hs : (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] s ≠ 0) :
   135	    Subsingleton ((M ⧸ Submodule.span B ({s} : Set M)) ⊗[B] K) := by
   136	  apply subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_finrank_eq_one
   137	    (Submodule.span B ({s} : Set M)).mkQ
   138	    (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _) s hfin hs
   139	  rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
   140	  exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self s
   141	
   142	end RankOneFibre
   143	
   144	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	/-!
    10	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
    11	
    12	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    13	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    14	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    15	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
    16	
    17	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    18	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    19	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
    21	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    30	
    31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    36	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    41	
    42	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    43	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    44	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    45	def PicRankOneOpen :
    46	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    47	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    48	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    49	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    50	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
    51	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    52	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    53	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    54	      apply Subtype.ext
    55	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    56	    rw [e]
    57	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)
    58	
    59	/-! ## The public membership contract -/
    60	
    61	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
    62	
    63	This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
    64	is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
    65	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
    66	def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
    67	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    68	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
    69	  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    70	    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    71	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    72	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))
    73	
    74	/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
    75	Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
    76	field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
    77	contract. -/
    78	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    79	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
    80	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
    81	      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    82	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    83	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    84	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
    85	  rfl
    86	
    87	/-- Constructor for the exact lambda-tied arbitrary-affine-pullback presentation contract. -/
    88	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations
    89	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    90	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    91	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    92	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    93	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    94	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :

    96	  (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mpr h
    97	
    98	/-- Constructor using the named arbitrary-affine producer predicate. -/
    99	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentationCondition
   100	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   101	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   102	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition pi lam) :
   103	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   104	  exact mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi h
   105	
   106	/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/
   107	def picRankOneOpenIncl :
   108	    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=
   109	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   110	
   111	/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.
   112	
   113	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
   114	defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
   115	relative-open gate below. -/
   116	def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
   117	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
   118	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
   119	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   120	
   121	/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.
   122	
   123	This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
   124	producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
   125	silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
   126	def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
   127	  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)
   128	
   129	/-! ## The explicit fibre producer contract -/
   130	
   131	/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.
   132	
   133	The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
   134	It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
   135	supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
   136	or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/
   137	structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   138	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   139	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   140	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
   141	  W : X.Opens
   142	  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   143	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
   144	  sq : fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
   145	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
   146	    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
   147	    (w : S ⟶ X),
   148	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
   149	      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
   150	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
   151	      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w
   152	
   153	namespace PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   154	
   155	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
   156	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   157	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))}
   158	
   159	/-- The fibre square supplied by `FibrePresented` is a pullback of presheaves. -/
   160	theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   161	    IsPullback D.fst (yoneda.map D.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g := by
   162	  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
   163	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
   164	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   165	  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   166	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) =>
   167	      φ.app S) D.sq
   168	  · rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
   169	    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp h₂
   170	  · intro v w hvw
   171	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
   172	    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩
   173	
   174	end PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   175	
   176	/-- An arbitrary-test fibre producer discharges the relative openness gate. -/
   177	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented
   178	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   179	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   180	        Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))),
   181	      PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   182	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   183	  refine MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists ?_
   184	  intro X g
   185	  let d := D X g
   186	  exact ⟨d.W, d.fst, d.W.ι, d.isPullback, inferInstance⟩
   187	
   188	/-- Expose a supplied relative-open certificate without hiding it behind typeclass search. -/
   189	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_certificate
   190	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi :=
   191	  h
   192	
   193	/-- Extract the open immersion supplied by the relative-openness certificate on an arbitrary
   194	pullback.  This is the exact shape consumed by an eventual chart/fibre producer. -/
   195	theorem picRankOneOpen_openPullback
   196	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)
   197	    {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
   198	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   199	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))
   200	    (fst : yoneda.obj Z ⟶
   201	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor)
   202	    (snd : Z ⟶ X)
   203	    (hpb : IsPullback fst (yoneda.map snd) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g) :
   204	    IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   205	  h.property g fst snd hpb
   206	
   207	/-- Pullback stability of the public rank-one locus, exposed independently of its definition. -/
   208	theorem picRankOneOpen_map_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}

?? AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/

/-- Expose a supplied relative-open certificate without hiding it behind typeclass search. -/
theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_certificate
    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi :=
  h

/-- Extract the open immersion supplied by the relative-openness certificate on an arbitrary
pullback.  This is the exact shape consumed by an eventual chart/fibre producer. -/
theorem picRankOneOpen_openPullback
    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))
    (fst : yoneda.obj Z ⟶
      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor)
    (snd : Z ⟶ X)
    (hpb : IsPullback fst (yoneda.map snd) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g) :
    IsOpenImmersion snd :=
  h.property g fst snd hpb

/-- Pullback stability of the public rank-one locus, exposed independently of its definition. -/
theorem picRankOneOpen_map_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
  (PicRankOneOpen pi).map f h

/-- Pullback stability of the public locus, with the base-change direction made explicit. -/
theorem picRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
  picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi f h

/-- The inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` under the affine widened Abel transformation.

This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))

/-- The same presentation preimage on the Yoneda functor of the canonical genus divisor
representer. -/
def divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter :
    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom

/-- The affine Abel transformation restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
def rankOneAbelAff :
    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶
      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
  (PicRankOneOpen pi).fromPreimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))

/-- Restrict the canonical representation isomorphism to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
def rankOneRepresenterRestriction :
    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom

/-- The represented genus Abel map restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
def rankOneAbelRepresented :
    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
  rankOneRepresenterRestriction pi ≫ rankOneAbelAff pi

/-- Immediate consumer theorem: the restricted represented Abel map lands in the public locus.
The stronger canonical inverse still needs the family-level divisor/evaluation producer; this
theorem records the exact target API that consumer lanes can use today. -/
theorem rankOneAbelRepresented_mem {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (x : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).obj T) :
    ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x :
      (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
  ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x).property

end

end AlgebraicGeometry
  rfl

/-- The certified open carrier has the universal rank-one predicate as its Yoneda range. -/
theorem divRankOneOpen_carrier_eq
    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier =
      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi :=
  h.carrier_eq

/-- Pointwise form of the witness equality, exposing the exact contract consumed by an inverse.

The right-hand side is the range of the open immersion, so a consumer can use this theorem to
replace a rank-one predicate proof by a factorisation through `DivRankOneOpen pi h`. -/
theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff
    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
      x ∈ (openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier).obj T := by
  rw [h.carrier_eq]

/-- A point of the universal rank-one predicate factors through the certified open immersion.

Unlike a bare range-membership proof, the conclusion exposes the source point and the equality
of its image with the given divisor point, which is the exact data needed by a canonical inverse. -/
theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization
    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk
          (h.carrier.ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom))).obj T,
        (openSubfunctorMap (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier).app T y = x := by
  rw [divRankOneOpen_mem_iff pi h x, openSubfunctor_mem_iff]

/-- The same factorisation contract with the named open object and slice inclusion.

The source in the preceding theorem is definitionally the slice object
`divRankOneOpenOver pi h`; this corollary gives the stable public names expected by inverse
consumers. -/
theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization_over
    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (divRankOneOpenOver pi h)).obj T,
        (yoneda.map (divRankOneOpenOverMap pi h)).app T y = x := by
  rw [divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization pi h x]
  rfl

/-- The exact inverse-facing factorisation for a point of the represented rank-one preimage.

The source point is retained as a subtype, so its membership proof is tied to the same divisor
that is factored through `DivRankOneOpenOver`; no unrelated class or top-open witness can satisfy
this endpoint. -/
theorem rankOneRepresenterRestriction_factorization
    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (x : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).obj T) :
    ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (divRankOneOpenOver pi h)).obj T,
      (yoneda.map (divRankOneOpenOverMap pi h)).app T y = x.1 := by
  apply (divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization_over pi h x.1).mp
  exact x.2

/-- Immediate inverse-facing consumer of Picard rank-one openness: every point of the represented
rank-one divisor preimage factors through the open carrier extracted from that certificate. -/
theorem rankOneRepresenterRestriction_factorization_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen
    (hPic : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)
    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (x : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).obj T) :
    ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (divRankOneOpenOver pi
        (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen pi hPic))).obj T,
      (yoneda.map (divRankOneOpenOverMap pi
        (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen pi hPic))).app T y = x.1 :=
  rankOneRepresenterRestriction_factorization pi
    (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen pi hPic) x

/-- A point in the certified open carrier is a point of the universal rank-one predicate. -/
theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_of_carrier
    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    {x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T}
    (hx : x ∈ (openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier).obj T) :
    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T := by
  exact (divRankOneOpen_mem_iff pi h x).mpr hx

/- The logical rank-one predicate remains stable under arbitrary pullback, independently of the
   geometric witness used to represent it by an open. -/
theorem divRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem
    {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (f : T ⟶ T')
    {x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T}
    (hx : x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T) :
    (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).map f x ∈
      (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T' :=
  (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).map f hx

end

end AlgebraicGeometry

    16	/-!
    17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
    18	
    19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
    20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
    21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
    22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
    23	
    24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
    25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
    26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
    27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
    28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
    29	
    30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
    31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
    32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
    33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
    34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
    35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
    36	-/

    59	/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.
    60	
    61	The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
    62	witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
    63	relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
    64	underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
    65	structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    66	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    67	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    68	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    69	  represents :
    70	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    71	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    72	  datum_class :
    73	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    74	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    75	  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
    76	  module_iso :
    77	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
    78	      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
    79	  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
    80	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    81	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    82	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    83	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    84	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    85	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    86	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app module)
    87	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
    88	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    89	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    90	  h0_rank_one :
    91	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
    92	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1

   127	/-- The canonical native pushforward base-change isomorphism supplied by the presentation.
   128	
   129	The isomorphism is not chosen independently: its hom is definitionally
   130	`(canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module`. -/
   131	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   132	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   133	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   134	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   135	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   136	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   137	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
   138	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   139	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   140	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) := by
   141	  exact @asIso _ _ _ _ ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module)

   144	/-- The native pushforward base-change isomorphism for an affine coefficient extension. -/
   145	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIsoAffine (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   146	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   147	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   148	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   149	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B)))).obj
   150	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   151	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   152	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   153	        (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))).obj
   154	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) :=
   155	  P.nativeBaseChangeIso

   157	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left

   161	/-- The source of evaluation identifies canonically with the source of evaluation after any
   162	cartesian base change. -/
   163	noncomputable def evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   164	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   165	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   166	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   167	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   168	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   169	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   170	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⋙
   171	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj
   172	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   173	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   174	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f').obj
   175	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) :=
   176	  ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   177	    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   178	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   179	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).app
   180	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   181	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)).symm) ≪≫
   182	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').mapIso (P.nativeBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq)

   184	/-- Under the source identification, evaluation after base change is the pullback of the
   185	presentation's original evaluation counit. -/
   186	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
   187	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   188	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   189	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   190	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   191	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   192	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   193	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq).hom ≫
   194	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   195	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) =
   196	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map P.evaluation := by
   197	  change ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   198	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   199	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   200	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).inv).app
   201	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   202	            (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)) ≫
   203	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module) ≫
   204	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   205	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module)) =
   206	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
   207	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   208	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module)
   209	  exact canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel sq P.module

    10	/-!
    11	# The general separably closed translated-cover producer
    12	
    13	This file closes the field-level producer left open by `Pic0SepClosedCover`.  For every field
    14	extension `K/k` and every `mu : picEt C (overSpec k K)`, it constructs the finite separable
    15	splitting field and all of `SepClosedTranslatedDropData`.
    16	
    17	The positive twist stays tied to the presenting class of `mu`.  Its exponent is chosen above
    18	both the FLV threshold and the amount needed to put the twisted class in degree at least the
    19	genus.  The dense-point, residue-one, finite-support, and base-subtraction fields are then filled
    20	by the rational-point-image constructor, so the output feeds the existing translated-drop
    21	consumer without replacing `mu` by an unrelated Picard class.
    22	-/

    53	The nested existential is the same finite-separable splitting package used by

    55	the given `mu`; the positive twist, its representative, and the later base subtraction all live

    57	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropData

    59	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra K L)
    60	        (_ : IsScalarTower k K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L)
    61	        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L),
    62	      Nonempty (SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu) := by
    63	  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, M₀, hM₀⟩ :=
    64	    exists_splitting_of_picEt C mu
    65	  letI := hLfield
    66	  letI := hkL
    67	  letI := hKL
    68	  letI := htow
    69	  letI := hfin
    70	  letI := hsep

    72	  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C L) := instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
    73	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
    74	      (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    75	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
    76	  haveI : QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    77	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
    78	  haveI : Module.Finite L
    79	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
    80	    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L
    81	  haveI : Module.Finite L
    82	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
    83	    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L

    86	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionSndLeft C L
    87	  haveI : IsProper (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
    88	    instIsProperSndLeft C L
    89	  haveI : GeometricallyIrreducible (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
    90	    instGeometricallyIrreducibleSndLeft C L
    91	  haveI : IsIntegral (baseChangeBundle C L).left :=
    92	    instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
    93	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
    94	      ((baseChangeBundle C L).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    95	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
    96	  haveI : QuasiCompact
    97	      ((baseChangeBundle C L).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    98	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
    99	  haveI : Module.Finite L

   101	    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L
   102	  haveI : Module.Finite L
   103	      (Sheaf.HModule ((baseChangeBundle C L).left.moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
   104	    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L

   106	  obtain ⟨pi, hpiFinite, hpiDominant, hpi⟩ :=
   107	    exists_isFinite_isDominant_toP1 (C := baseChangeBundle C L)
   108	  letI : IsFinite pi := hpiFinite
   109	  letI : IsDominant pi := hpiDominant

   111	  let thetaL : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CechPic :=
   112	    Scheme.CechPic.map ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (Algebra.ofId k L)).left)

   116	    exact one_le_classDeg_cechPicMap_baseFieldTransition_of_one_le
   117	      (C := C) (Algebra.ofId k L) (thetaCechClass C)
   118	      (one_le_classDeg_thetaCechClass (C := C))

   121	    exists_positive_twist_vanishing pi hpi M₀ thetaL hthetaL
   122	  let deficit : ℕ := ((genus C : ℤ) - classDeg L M₀).toNat
   123	  let m : ℕ := n₀ + deficit
   124	  have hn₀m : n₀ ≤ m := by
   125	    simp [m]
   126	  have hdeficitm : deficit ≤ m := by
   127	    simp [m]
   128	  have hdegreeClass : (genus C : ℤ) ≤ classDeg L (M₀ * thetaL ^ m) := by

   134	      exact_mod_cast hdeficitm

   148	            (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)) =
   149	        thetaL ^ m := by

   151	    exact map_pow (Scheme.CechPic.map
   152	      ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (Algebra.ofId k L)).left)) (thetaCechClass C) m
   153	  have hWtheta :
   154	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀ = M₀ * thetaL ^ m := by
   155	    rw [hW₀raw, hchart]
   156	  have hdegreeW₀ :
   157	      (genus C : ℤ) ≤ Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ := by
   158	    rw [← classDeg_picClass L W₀, hWtheta]
   159	    exact hdegreeClass

   161	      (Sheaf.HModule ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1) :=

   168	    sub_nonneg.mpr hdegreeW₀
   169	  have hdegreeExact :
   170	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ = (genus C : ℤ) + excess := by
   171	    dsimp [excess]
   172	    rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hexcessNonnegative]
   173	    ring

   175	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
   176	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   177	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   178	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   179	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   180	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
   181	  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   182	    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
   183	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
   184	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   185	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   186	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
   187	  let M₀rel : (relCurve C L).CechPic := M₀
   188	  have hM₀rel : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K mu) =
   189	      PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀rel) := by
   190	    simpa only [M₀rel] using hM₀

   192	  refine ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, ?_⟩
   193	  exact ⟨sepClosedTranslatedDropDataOfRationalPointImage
   194	    mu m M₀rel hM₀rel W₀ (by
   195	      rw [relCurveMap_eq_overSpecMap_ofId]
   196	      change Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀ =
   197	        M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map
   198	          ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (Algebra.ofId k L)).left)
   199	          (chartTwistClass C m
   200	            (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor))
   201	      exact hW₀raw) excess hdegreeExact h1W₀⟩

   203	/-- Immediate consumer of the general producer through the existing translated-drop theorem.
   204	
   205	The result retains the chosen subtraction divisor and its descended base-field divisor, and its
   206	last field is the `IsSplitWitness` for this exact input `mu` translated by that exact base class. -/
   207	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult_general
   208	    (mu : picEt C (overSpec k K)) :
   209	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra K L)
   210	        (_ : IsScalarTower k K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L)
   211	        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)
   212	        (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu),
   213	      Nonempty (SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu d) := by
   214	  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, ⟨d⟩⟩ :=

   217	  letI := hkL
   218	  letI := hKL
   219	  letI := htow
   220	  letI := hfin
   221	  letI := hsep
   222	  exact ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d,

    17	rather than adding `residueDeg = 1` as an unrelated existential field.  The relative specialization
    18	is the exact point produced by `Over.rationalPointBaseChange`.

    35	/-! ## Sections have residue degree one -/
    36	
    37	theorem residueDeg_one_of_section
    38	    {K : Type u} [Field K]
    39	    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))}
    40	    {e : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ X.left}
    41	    (he : e ≫ X.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    42	    {x : X.left}
    43	    (hx : e.base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) = x) :
    44	    X.left.residueDeg K x = 1 := by
    45	  letI : Algebra K (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) := stalkAlgebra X.hom x
    46	  have h := bijective_algebraMap_residueField_of_section X he hx
    47	  have hmap :
    48	      algebraMap K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)) =
    49	        X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x := by
    50	    ext c
    51	    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    52	      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)),
    53	      IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_eq, Scheme.residueOverAlgebraMap,
    54	      algebraMap_overStalkAlgebra]
    55	    simp [stalkStructureHom, Scheme.overAlgebraMap]
    56	    rfl
    57	  letI : Algebra K (X.left.residueField x) :=
    58	    (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x).toAlgebra
    59	  unfold Scheme.residueDeg
    60	  change Module.finrank K (X.left.residueField x) = 1
    61	  apply Module.finrank_of_bijective_algebraMap
    62	  change Function.Bijective (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x)
    63	  rw [← hmap]
    64	  exact h

    71	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]

    74	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).residueDeg L
    75	      ((Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint L)) = 1 := by
    76	  apply residueDeg_one_of_section
    77	    (X := Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k L)).left)

    82	/-- The graph point of a field-valued point has residue degree one. -/
    83	theorem residueDeg_one_of_graphPoint
    84	    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    85	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    86	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    87	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    88	    (t : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
    89	    (C ⊗ overSpec k K).left.residueDeg K (Over.graphPoint C t) = 1 := by
    90	  exact residueDeg_one_of_section
    91	    (X := Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k K)).left)
    92	    (e := (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left)
    93	    (by
    94	      exact congrArg (fun q : overSpec k K ⟶ overSpec k K => q.left)
    95	        (Over.sectionOfPoint_snd t))
    96	    (by
    97	      change (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) =
    98	        (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base default
    99	      exact congrArg (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base
   100	        (Subsingleton.elim _ _))

   102	/-- The graph presentation has multiplicity one at its graph point.
   103	
   104	`presentationDivisor_graphLocalEquations` initially records the multiplicity as an order.
   105	The graph class and its residue field both have degree one, so the degree formula forces that
   106	order to be one.  This is the pointwise input for finite-support class descent below. -/
   107	theorem graphPicClass_eq_picClass_single
   108	    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   109	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   110	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   111	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   112	    (t : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
   113	    Over.graphPicClass C t =
   114	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K
   115	        (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single (graphPoint_ne_genericPoint C t) 1) := by
   116	  let hx := graphPoint_ne_genericPoint C t
   117	  let a : ℤ :=
   118	    Multiplicative.toAdd
   119	      (Scheme.ordZ ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
   120	        hx ((Over.graphLocalEquations C t).presentation.elem (Over.graphPoint C t)))
   121	  have hsingle :
   122	      Scheme.presentationDivisor K (Over.graphLocalEquations C t).presentation =
   123	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx a := by
   124	    exact presentationDivisor_graphLocalEquations C t
   125	  have hclass :
   126	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx a) =
   127	        Over.graphPicClass C t := by
   128	    rw [← hsingle, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_presentationDivisor K,
   129	      Scheme.LocalEquations.presentation_picClass]
   130	    rfl
   131	  have hdeg := classDeg_graphPicClass C t
   132	  rw [← hclass, classDeg_picClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_single'] at hdeg
   133	  rw [residueDeg_one_of_graphPoint C t, Nat.cast_one, mul_one] at hdeg
   134	  rw [hdeg] at hclass

   239	/-- A divisor whose finite support consists of base-changed rational points has a Picard class

   245	theorem exists_baseClass_of_supported_on_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   246	    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   247	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   248	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]

   252	      (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   253	      coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L) :
   254	    ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   255	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   256	        Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c := by

   258	      x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left} →₀ ℤ,
   259	      (∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   260	        (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   261	        coeffAt hx f ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L) →
   262	      ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   263	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L f =
   264	          Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c from hmain S hsupp

   271	        (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor) =
   272	          Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) 1

   276	      intro hsupport

   279	        apply hsupport p.1 p.2
   280	        change (Finsupp.single p b + f) p ≠ 0
   281	        rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same, hfp, add_zero]

   284	          (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),

   286	        intro x hx hfx
   287	        apply hsupport x hx
   288	        change (Finsupp.single p b + f) ⟨x, hx⟩ ≠ 0
   289	        have hxp : (⟨x, hx⟩ : {z : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
   290	            z ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left}) ≠ p := by
   291	          intro heq
   292	          subst p
   293	          exact hfx hfp
   294	        rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hxp, zero_add]

   297	        exists_baseClass_picClass_single_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   298	          C p.1 p.2 hpMem

   301	            Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L D =
   302	              Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) cf) →
   303	          ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   304	            Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L
   305	              (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single p.2 b + D) =
   306	              Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c := by
   307	        intro D hD
   308	        obtain ⟨cf, hcf⟩ := hD
   309	        refine ⟨cp ^ b * cf, ?_⟩
   310	        unfold relCurveMap relCurve at hcp hcf ⊢
   311	        rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_add,
   312	          ← Scheme.picClass_single_zpow L p.2 b, hcp, hcf, map_mul, map_zpow]

   315	/-- Exact discharge of `SepClosedTranslatedDropData.baseSubtraction` for the rational-point
   316	image.  The descended class is re-presented by an actual base-field divisor `Z`; at exponent
   317	zero, the inverse of `chartTwistClass C 0 Z` is precisely `picClass k Z`. -/
   318	theorem exists_baseSubtraction_of_supported_on_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   319	    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   320	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   321	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   322	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   323	    (S : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor)
